slices.focus: Spring completion meetings confirm back-to-back strong cohorts; first-year system becomes permanent program
slices.summary: The spring completion meetings mark the ultimate validation: back-to-back stronger cohorts, improved first-to-third-year retention, fewer repeat preventable safety write-ups, and foremen asking for redesigned-class graduates by name. The room's tone shifts from 'let's see if this experiment keeps working' to 'this is how first year runs now.' Derek feels relief more than pride — the emotional burden of proving the model lifts as the system institutionalizes. He resolves to write non-negotiables, set a review cadence, and formally distinguish between what must stay fixed and what is open to instructor style.

Setting a simple review checkpoint to prevent drift

Letting the relief settle before jumping into the next improvement
